status: Primary-source review; no numerical score, implementation admission or scoring change
question: Whether finite internal simulation noise or representation can be improved without invalid fairness assumptions

evidence.publication: Ferro2014 Fair scores for ensemble forecasts,doi10.1002/qj.2270
evidence.finding: Finite-ensemble score and underlying-distribution score differ; fair correction requires appropriate assumptions on member law/dependence.

evidence.publication: Roberts2026 Ensemble-size-dependence of methods minimizing (un)fair score
evidence.finding: Exchangeability/conditional independence assumptions matter; structural member dependence can invalidate naive fairCRPS corrections. Do not apply an iid adjustment blindly to correlated/antithetic mean ensembles.

decision: Do not change panel score or admit a naive fairCRPS inner replacement from this review. Current mean ensembles are stratified/antithetic and share fitted parameters; derive applicability before any correction.

credible_followup.mechanism: Antithetic Gaussian/Student innovation sampling as a coherent joint-path component option
credible_followup.why_distinct: Existing mean uncertainty uses stratification but forecast innovations currently use ordinary Gaussian/radial RNG. A source prototype asset_antithetic exists but is unqualified/unadmitted, not a prior losing screen.
requirements: Preserve joint innovation and marginal path laws; Student radial draw shared within a sign pair
Do not sign-flip empirical residuals or raw rows, which would alter their asymmetric distribution
Check seeded/chunk invariance and full asset/portfolio accounting
Same empirical mixture CRPS and1000official members; only representative/broader matched tests can establish improvement
